solvableByProgramProtocol: Separate action dispatch success from semantic postcondition success; require explicit postconditions for open, close, switch, and navigation.
Treat sibling header-menu switching as a reusable lifecycle strategy only after matching visible-owner replacement postconditions.
Persist reviews by stable logical identity only within the same document and rebind to a current localId; invalidate instance approvals when documentId changes.
Wait for loading regions to settle and re-observe before declaring a list empty, complete, or ready for sampling.
Discover candidate custom collections from a shared visible owner, repeated role/tag/action/href shape, and current-observation membership; never mix historical members into the active sample.
On navigation, automatically create a page boundary decision, limit destination actions, history-return, and force fresh entry-document review.
Keep skipped or unsampled members as explicit untested coverage instead of deleting them from the frontier.
requiresCurrentPageFacts: Whether an overlay is actually open, closed, replaced, loaded, visible, or hittable.
Which current localId corresponds to a named control after re-render or return.
Whether visually similar rows truly share one owner and operation structure.
The actual href, label, selected state, accessibility state, occlusion, and scroll boundary of each current node.
requiresUpstreamPurposeJudgment: Whether a discovered collection should be exhausted, sampled, deferred, or skipped.
Which members are representative when business purposes differ despite structural similarity.
Whether an unnamed or pointer-only custom target has enough evidence for a specific purpose.
How deeply a destination may be explored and whether persistent preference changes are in scope.
Risk and replayability where the UI evidence does not establish business side effects.
